en: The monstrous, elemental protector of a force known as The Green, Swamp Thing represents the ultimate loss of humanity. With his mortal body destroyed but his memories still intact, Holland is forced to constantly war with his own nature, unable to reconcile the reality of his new life against that which was taken from him. Still, challenging as the role of Swamp Thing might be, the monsters powers and responsibilities afforded to those who take on the role are far more important than any mere human's past.

Instead of truly being a part of the syndicate and assisting them, Martin Stein utilized their high-tech equipment to continue his experiments. 
Growing dissatisfied with experimenting on others, Martin Stein began using himself as the subject. He managed to fuse his mind and body with a corpse, and Deathstorm, the counterpart of Prime Earth's Firestorm, was created.

Following this incident, Jessica developed anxiety resulting in self-imposed exile, and she locked herself in her apartment for four years.\nDuring this time, the Crime Syndicate had taken over the Prime Earth and exiled their heroic counterparts. During the invasion of Earth, Power Ring was killed by Sinestro, and his ring forced itself onto Jessica Cruz. Eventually, it took over her entire body and bent her to its will. Under the negative influence of the Ring of Volthoom, Jessica attacked her hometown and fought the combined forces of the Justice League and the Doom Patrol.

But during one of his performances he was murdered in midair by a mysterious assassin -- known only as "The Hook." When he died, his spirit was granted the power to possess any living being by the Hindu god Rama Kushna, so that Boston could search for his killer and receive a measure of peace. Now a literal Deadman, he was both a ghost and a Super Hero.\nAlthough Deadman would eventually catch his murderer, who'd killed him as part of an elaborate initiation ritual to join an elite group of assassins, he continued to use his abilities to help people in the mortal world.

In Gotham City, people are never quite what they seem—sometimes literally. As one of the most skilled and dangerous shape-shifters, Clayface is a complicated and multifaceted rogue who oozes in and out of different roles with the fluidity of the mud that makes up his body.

Basil Karlo, began as an up-and-coming movie star set to take on a breakout part as the villain in a film. Before the movie began filming, however, Basil was in a car accident that left the majority of his body horribly disfigured and scarred.

Basil's body was completely melted down into a mud-like clay, capable of shape-shifting and size-changing. But with this transformation came the final break in his already-fractured mind. Clayface was officially born.

Many years later, a dying alien named Abin Sur, member of the Green Lantern Corps, crash-landed his starship in the Californian desert. Having selected a replacement officer for his position, the power ring chose Hal Jordan for his ability to overcome great fear. As Green Lantern, Hal Jordan patrolled the galaxy and took on many missions in space. He was also one of the founding members of the Justice League of America.

Few villains are Superman's equal in power, but there is one who can always go toe to toe with the Man of Steel in a fight -- his twisted doppelganger, Bizarro. The tragic result of a bizarre science experiment gone horribly wrong, Bizarro is an imperfect duplicate of Kal-El, with none of his intelligence or self-control. Looking like a pasty white, zombie-like version of the Last Son of Krypton, he invariably strikes fear into those he encounters. Often a creature more to be pitied than feared, Bizarro nevertheless is as dangerous as it gets -- whether he means to be lethal or not. \n\nUsually wanting nothing more than to be seen as the hero that his famous counterpart Superman is, he has often developed a strong hatred for his "perfect" brother. Few have mastered the human brain as thoroughly, or maliciously, as Dr. Jonathan Crane, a.k.a. the Scarecrow. A brilliant though troubled psychologist, Crane dedicated his life to understanding exactly how the emotion of fear works in the body and mind.

She used the power to help Martin Stein and Steve Trevor rescue the Justice League.

Explanation: 角色档案故事康斯坦丁
en: A notorious con man and grifter whose past has a body count, Constantine's moral compass is as gray as can be. He's an expert sorcerer and magician, but also an accomplished liar and thief known for his vices, self-loathing and on-again-off-again death wish. His abilities have afforded him the opportunity not only to cheat death, but to trick the forces that govern Heaven and Hell... meaning he has no shortage of powerful enemies. \n\nStill, although John's motives may be suspect more often than not, with enough effort, his selfishness can be chipped away, revealing a decent person buried beneath a carefully crafted persona. A lifetime of pain and suffering has hardened the Hellblazer on the outside, but, deep down, he wants to do the right thing.

en: A master of boomerangs and boomerang-based fighting, Digger Harkness began his career promoting toy boomerangs. After he immigrated from Australia to the United States, his life took a sharp left turn into villainy when he decided to use his skills to steal jewels. He developed a line of weaponized boomerangs, terrorizing Central City until he ran afoul of the Flash. Their battles usually ended with Digger in prison. But in lieu of serving out his entire sentence, he was offered a position on the Suicide Squad.  \nWith the Squad, Digger now works alongside some of the most dangerous criminals in the world. But if he sometimes finds his teammates' metahuman abilities intimidating, he never lets it get the better of him. Digger's skill with a boomerang is exceeded only by his total self-interest in any given situation.

He has also occasionally worked with Earth's heroes and the U.S. government to protect the planet or serve what he considers to be a greater good. But despite his occasional heroics, Slade Wilson ultimately deferred to whatever benefited himself, finding loopholes in his own code of honor to justify betrayal and manipulation.

Zatanna's power comes from magic, and the energy is unstable. As far as I know, she's lost her magic plenty of times in different situations. I think it has something to do with the psychological trauma she's been through.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Zatanna belongs to the well-known Homo Magi race. From an early age, she has shown an amazing talent for spells and magic, and her attainments far exceed those of her father. She's one of the first members of the Justice League and one of the founders of the Justice League Dark. She's warm and kind most of the time and can perfectly balance the two identities of a stage magician and an actual magician. But she is also prone to emotional instability and makes bad judgment calls.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Zatanna and I were lovers, we've known each other since we were teenagers. Although our relationship was over, I'd always thought she was one of the few people I could trust completely, until I discovered that I had been brainwashed by her mind-wiping skill. I followed the lead and found that she—or they had interfered with the memories of countless people over the years. Zatanna tried to convince herself that she was protecting their secret identities, but it was clear that she was overwhelmed. She even lost her magic due to stress for a time. After regaining her power, she assured me she would never use that magic again. I'll keep an eye on her.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Years later, I still remember her and Dick as children helping me fight crime. They're my most important partners and allies. I never regretted accepting Barbara as my disciple, but the harm Joker did to her still hurts me deeply. Fortunately, she stood up again.
Without the amulet, Isis is an ordinary person. Of note, when necessary, we may be able to control her through her relationship with Black Adam.
Without his Cold Gun, Leonard is just an ordinary guy. He shouldn't be too difficult to deal with. Lisa Snart, the Golden Glider, is his sister who we will be focusing on.

With the blessing of the Greek gods, Diana is unparalleled in body, mind, and spirit. She possesses the Lasso of Truth, Bracelets of Victory, Sword of Hephaestus, Power Shield, and other weapons forged by the gods and Amazon technology, and is very good at using them.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述3（完整）
en: Whoever wants to be friends with Damian deserves a Nobel Peace Prize.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Who would have guessed that under her charming blond hair was a black-haired beauty? I mean, Dinah is a superb covert operative.

While Bruce's deceased parents have always been his soft spot, Batman's weakness is the growing "family" he's taken under his wing. Besides, without the high-tech suit and weapons, he's just a human without superpowers.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: While Barry Allen isn't the originator of the Flash, he's undoubtedly the one who has carried the title forward. The Central City forensic scientist's transformation into a super hero is coincidental and dramatic: He was struck by a bolt of lightning at work and doused by chemicals. He awoke later to find himself connected to a mysterious force field he called "Speed Force", which gave him super speed. Since then, Barry Allen has used that power to exact justice and fight evil.

Whether she can walk or not, Barbara's fighting skills should not be underestimated. Even Nightwing couldn't subdue her in her heyday. Barbara's hacking skills are slightly superior to Tim's, and she's good at tracking and stealth.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Whether as a scientist, businessman, or even as the President of the United States, Lex Luthor has taken his xenophobia and human supremacy to the extreme. He could have used his ability, power, and influence to help mankind, but Luthor attempted to fight Superman. Even if he's willing to fight the Syndicate and other criminals that threaten Earth, I still don't think I can trust him for long.
When wearing Hatshepsut's amulet, Isis possesses the powers of flight, object manipulation, telekinesis, elemental control, healing, and more by reciting spells.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述3（完整）
en: When I first got out of my wheelchair, Dinah thought I no longer needed her help. But the truth is that I'll always need her.
When driven into a frenzy, Nanaue becomes more powerful but loses the ability to think rationally.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: We may have underestimated Poison Ivy's threat level, and from what I've heard, not only Superman, but many other superhumans have sustained heavy losses as a result of her mind control. However, we must be aware that she is far from hopelessly evil. Gotham has pushed too many people over the edge, she's one of those people, and maybe I am too. She has a strong attachment to certain things and people, so in specific situations with specific people, she has a special sense of justice. This is her weakness but will also help us rein her in in key moments.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Waller thought she had everything under control, so she unleashed King Shark's power, like Pandora opening the box. King Shark's destructive power and his bloodthirsty nature are beyond his control, and his powerful regeneration ability revives him repeatedly. We keep him under close surveillance, even if there's still a trace of sanity in him.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Victor Stone, a former high school football star, was seriously injured by a high-tech Mother Box from Apokolips in a lab accident. His scientist father rescued him with alien technology from the Red Room. Influenced by the explosion of the Mother Box, Victor Stone eventually absorbed a large number of mechanical devices and alien technology from the Red Room and transformed into Cyborg.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Victor is still a young man. He's obviously not very mature, but he has a lot of potential for improvement. Victor used to struggle to walk the line between humanity and reason, but now he's made his choice. At the same time, Victor's special connection with Apokolips technology has brought us unlimited opportunities and unpredictable crises. When I saw him, I occasionally wondered whether we were ready enough to deal with the world on the other side of the Boom Tube.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Victor Fries was once a gifted scientist. He froze his terminally ill wife Nora to give her the time she needed as he searched for a cure. The company that funded Victor wanted to halt the experiment, which came to a head in the lab, resulting in a tragic accident. The accident altered Victor's body. To survive, his body temperature must remain at a temperature below zero, so he developed cryogenic armor as well as a variety of cryogenic weapons, becoming Mr. Freeze.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Unlike other opponents with great strength, Bane has superior intelligence and tactical ability, and is extremely principled. I was paralyzed and thought I was going to die after he broke my spine in public, I had to let Jean-Paul and Dick fill in the role of Batman after that. And he has since become famous for being one of the fears I had to face and overcome in my life—which I did, thankfully.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Traumatized by the incident, Jessica Cruz was stricken with debilitating anxiety and was taken over by the Ring of Volthoom, becoming the new Power Ring. It took a long time for her to overcome the ring after I convinced her to overcome the influence of the ring. During the Darkseid War, she showed her bravery by sacrificing herself to prevent the Black Racer from killing the Flash, which led to a Green Lantern Ring choosing her, making her the newest Green Lantern.

Tim's genius intellect made him not only a top detective, but a great hacker and a young CEO of Wayne Enterprises. Like every Robin, Tim has undergone intensive training to fight. While sparring, his baton skills even outdo Damian.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Tim resembles me the most. He's the only Robin who relies on pure and calculated reason, and he's also the one with the greatest detective talent. If anyone else acquired this quality, I'd worry about them using it for the wrong things. But Tim is compassionate by nature. From the moment he came to me, he'd proven that he couldn't abandon others in a place where they could be hurt. I'll develop Tim's other abilities more carefully. I'm sure he's capable of taking over my cape.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Tim Drake grew up in Gotham. Thanks to his outstanding detective talent, he discovered Batman and Robin's true identities. After Jason's death, he came to me when I was on the verge of collapse and became the new Robin. At first, Tim thought Robin would be the end of his vigilante life and left the Batman Family for a while. After a series of events, he eventually donned his cape again and became an important member of the family.

There's no doubt that Constantine is an expert sorcerer proficient in all kinds of spells, sorcery, illusions, and so on. He can also control the probability of things, foretell the future, and use magic to protect himself. He's resourceful and adept at strategy and speech, with a good degree of fighting skills.
There is no doubt that the Question is adept in the magic arts. When the Council of Eternity sentenced the Trinity of Sin to eternal life, they also granted them the ability to harness magic.

There are audio recordings of Dinah's sonic attacks in the Batcave. According to several studies conducted by Nightwing and me, reversing the sound waves she produces cancels out her ability. In this way, her deadly Canary Cry can be weaponized against her.

The yellow sun gives Superman many extraordinary gifts. Flight, super hearing, heat vision, super-breath... Superman seemingly gains abilities without limit. I'll keep track of his new abilities and prepare for them.

The power of Sinestro's Yellow Lantern Ring is negatively affected by the presence of a Blue Lantern Ring. The Yellow Lantern Ring also needs to be charged to maintain energy, just like the Green Lantern Ring. Unlike the Green Lantern Ring, which bases its energy on will, the Yellow Lantern Ring's energy is based on fear. But when Sinestro himself is the one afraid, he is unable to draw out its power.

Kyle requires a Lantern Ring to fuel his powers. Separated from it, he is little more than an ordinary human. Wielding the power of a White Lantern Ring specifically requires emotional stability. If Kyle were to become emotionally compromised, it's possible his metahuman abilities would as well. Furthermore, tapping into the entire Emotional Spectrum at once is extremely taxing on the body, and can leave Kyle vulnerable.

The Speed Force grants Barry not only super speed, but also rapid healing and exceptional cogitation, super strength, and many other shocking abilities. In one sense, this is probably the most fearsome power among us. If he wants to, he can even reverse time and change everything.

The Speed Force granted Kid Flash extraordinary speed, rapid healing, and exceptional cogitation. The Flash, Kid Flash's predecessor who originally discovered the Speed Force, can travel through time and space. Kid Flash may also acquire this ability in the future.
The Question's greatest weakness is the unknown. He will go to any length to find the answer he seeks for as long as it takes, for eternity.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: The Question, along with Pandora and the Phantom Stranger, are called the Trinity of Sin as the greatest sinners ever. His true identity remains unknown. They say that because the wizards of the Council of Eternity feared his name, they erased his face and memory, cursing him to wander the Earth forever, constantly questioning everything and seeking answers he can never find. But that doesn't explain why he cares about justice.

The power of the Star Sapphire Ring bestows Carol the power to generate force fields, create constructs, fly, and much more. Plus, as a Star Sapphire, she can use the ring to instill feelings of love or jealousy in others.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: The origin of Pandora differs from the myth that we know. She is the same as Vandal Savage, a living immortal. But unlike Savage, her immortality was a punishment imposed by the Council of Eternity for opening the box which released the Seven Deadly Sins upon the world.

The mortal body is barely one of Green Arrow's weaknesses, but I think his greatest weakness is those he cherishes, including his deceased parents, Dinah, Roy, Connor, and Hal. Besides, his slightly extreme thoughts are also his weakness.

The meteorite's radiation gave the gorillas of Gorilla City incredible intelligence and strength, and Grodd developed strong mental powers, allowing him to be telepathic. He's used this ability to mind-control others on numerous occasions.
The Guardians regard him as "dangerous, unstable, and uncontrollable" because of his defiance of authority, confidence, and fearlessness. His unplanned and risky actions often put himself in danger.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: The Flash's true identity is a forensic scientist with great detective skills, so he and Bruce have a lot in common. Not many people can impress Bruce in this regard. Besides, he also has a "family". An old friend of mine and I used to play the chief assistants.

The Flash has plenty of experience in dealing with Grodd. This highly intelligent gorilla is quick-tempered, which can throw a wrench in his operations; he's joined some criminal organizations but is not good at working with people.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: The current Firestorm is a fusion of Ronald Raymond and Jason Rusch, with Ronald controlling the body. He was caught in the explosion center of an atomic bomb dropped by the "antinuclear team", and now he possesses the ability of Firestorm. After the death of the original Firestorm, Professor Stein, Jason became Ronald's partner. They can become Firestorm on their own or fuse to become stronger.

Thanks to Apokolips technology, most of Cyborg's body has been built into cybernetic parts with a variety of special abilities and devices, including mechanical controls, two Sonic Cannons, and jets that can be used for flight. He has the data processing power of a supercomputer, and at the same time, his body and strength have been greatly improved.
Tamaraneans can absorb ultraviolet radiation and convert it into superpowers, such as visual enhancement and flight. Starfire can also release her absorbed energy into incredibly powerful blasts.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Superman is a survivor from Krypton, a planet that no longer exists. Before Krypton's destruction, Superman was sent to Earth by his parents in an airship when he was an infant. The ship crashed in Smallville, Kansas and was hidden from the government by the Kents. The Kents raised him to be a kind person.
Starfire is often haunted by her past. The justice and mercy she learned on Earth are not enough to completely suppress the wild and fighting instincts of the Tamaraneans.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Starfire is a princess from the planet Tamaran in line to the throne. After a coup took place on the planet, she and her eldest sister, Komand'r (also known as Blackfire), were captured and became slaves, undergoing a series of inhumane experiments. In the experiment, Starfire luckily gained a new ability and rescued her sister. However, Blackfire didn't appreciate Starfire's help. She turned her back on her sister and wanted to kill her. Starfire was exiled to Earth where she joined the Teen Titans.

Star Sapphire was once brainwashed by the Zamarons, which suggests that she is vulnerable to mind control. Furthermore, as a fighter fueled by love, Hal Jordan is also her fatal weakness. She may no longer be able to wear the ring if she is no longer in love with Hal.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Sometimes you can say it, Bruce. You know I have access to the file, right? Anyway, thank you, Batman.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Slade Wilson's experience is simple yet complex. He is a distinguished military agent whose body was transformed by secret experiments and gained the ability to heal quickly as well as boosted physical attributes. Perhaps achieving his goals and pursuing his interests has always been his code of conduct. After leaving the army, he donned a mask and became the feared super-powered mercenary Deathstroke.

Slade is the deadliest assassin in the world. His accelerated healing and physical abilities are far above that of a normal person after his transformation. He is a master of martial arts, and his sharp mind makes him a tactical genius. Slade often carries dual katanas and various types of guns, but he is proficient in a wide range of weapons.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Slade is on the list of villains, but he often acts heroically. I've long been his enemy, but I've also fought alongside him on multiple times, and I understand his contradictory behavior. His code of conduct is neither good nor evil; he is more driven by his own interests and desires. Following orders and taking out targets, from soldier to mercenary, Deathstroke hits the winning stroke.

Sinestro's power comes from the Yellow Lantern Ring, a ring he made in the Antimatter Universe, which is powered by fear. Similar to the Green Lantern Ring, the Yellow Lantern's energy grants him flight, the ability to survive, and the ability to create constructs of any shape and size.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Sinestro, whose full name is Thaal Sinestro, is a former Green Lantern Corps member. He was dedicated to preserving order and used the power of the Green Lantern Ring to enslave his home planet, Korugar. After Hal Jordan discovered what had occurred, the Guardians of the Universe took back the ring and exiled Sinestro to the Antimatter Universe. However, Sinestro acquired the Yellow Lantern Ring, which originates from the power of fear, and made a comeback with it.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Sinestro is undoubtedly one of the Justice League's greatest enemies. He is calm and cruel, with tremendous combat experience and excellent leadership abilities. Hal Jordan has always had illusions about Sinestro. I don't deny that his talent is on par with the Green Lantern, but his cruelty and evil are inherent, just like his strong willpower. Sinestro is by no means the "hero" Hal wants.

She's like a cheetah, with sharp toes, a strong physique, and a bloodthirsty nature. It's even harder to cope with her amazing speed, which causes Diana a lot of trouble. According to the data I've recorded, she can even compete with the Speedsters.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: She is undoubtedly as beautiful as she is dangerous. I mean, not to emphasize this to Batman, whether you're male or female, always be wary of her kisses.
Selina isn't a fighter. She's not good at fighting head-on.
Selina is well-trained all-around and good at raids and action among the buildings, she can pass almost every security system. Her claws and whip strengthen her in fights.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Selina claims to have her own "moral standards", which change with her mood and aren't reliable. I have to admit, I've always trusted Selina, except for her stealing and making fun of the police and vigilantes. She hates killing and refuses to get blood on her hands. From this point of view, she's likely to get better.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Selina calls herself a thief, but she's actually more like a bounty hunter. She was an orphan and grew up in a detention center in Gotham. One day, she found the detention center's administrator had been embezzling funds and abusing children, so she fled with her friends. But they fell in with a gang of thieves and she was trained to be a talented thief. Selina managed to escape when she grew up. She disguises herself as a socialite to approach the upper class. Once she has a target, Catwoman will visit their homes and sweep away all their jewelry.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述3（完整）
en: Scars make some people afraid and hesitant to take risks, let alone take chances. But for me, that scar is what keeps me going. I won't fall again.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Scarecrow's and my thinking are similar in some ways; we both use fear, but we've taken different paths. In addition to fear toxin, his research into the psychology of fear should be taken seriously, because the mind is more dangerous than any physical weapon.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Samuel "Sam" Joseph Scudder. During a shift at a mirror factory, he accidentally mixed some chemicals in a mirror, and the mirror—which should have been scrapped—was given the ability to connect to other dimensions. Scudder studied the mirror and gained teleportation and the ability to create duplicates with any mirror, making him one of the Flash's most powerful enemies.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Revenge shaped Helena and almost destroyed her, which is not much different from my experience and helps me understand her. I used to think she was unreasonable and violent, but it can't be neglected that Helena is growing up. Dick and Tim both worked closely with her, and she's now a member of the Birds of Prey. At least for now, we can say it was the right decision to take Huntress under the wing of Batman Incorporated.

Red Hood's weapons of choice are a crowbar and a pistol. As my apprentice, he has excellent detective and reasoning skills and is proficient in hand-to-hand combat. Besides, he's skillful at using all kinds of firearms.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Rachel's mother is human, and her father is the demon Trigon. Rachel revealed her great magical power at a young age, but due to her emotions, she often lost control and hurt innocent people, so she needed constant practice and meditation to control her emotions. She learned magic to control her magic and how to be a hero, rejecting the fate set upon her by the demonic force that ran through her veins. When she met the Teen Titans, she joined this found family of teenagers.

Rachel was born with powerful magical abilities due to her demonic bloodline. Flight, psychokinesis, psychic links, emotional manipulation, teleportation... She can also absorb the pain of the injured to cure them and stop time for a short while. She also excels as a combatant.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Rachel Roth has spent her life trying to find a balance between the light and darkness. She learned to control her magic and how to be a hero, rejecting the fate set by the demonic force that ran through her veins. But no matter how powerful her friends and allies were, the threat of her father loomed. Fortunately, Rachel met the Teen Titans during the most difficult time in her life, and the company of these fine young heroes allowed her to briefly escape her father's influence and enjoy life as a normal teenager.

Rachel is afraid of causing harm to those around her because of her uncontrollable powers, so she keeps her distance from people at all times. Her father, Trigon, has been her constant nightmare throughout her entire life.

Poison Ivy's obsession with plants and the environment is unimaginable. It is well known that excessive obsession can lead to weakness. And, by extension, she cares about someone. Pay close attention to her relationship with Harley Quinn, as this could be a vital entry point.

Poison Ivy was almost killed by those toxic chemicals, but they also gave her the ability to manipulate plants with her mind and made her immune to the majority of poisons and viruses. Furthermore, her body can produce lethal toxins or hormones that control or seduce people.

Immortal and at least semi-omniscient, the Phantom Stranger is one of the most powerful magic users on Earth. He is capable of divining the future, pausing time, manipulating emotions, and even altering reality, though the true extent of his power is unknown.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: The Phantom Stranger and I are kindred spirits. We are both sinners in desperate search for our absolution but denied the means to achieve it by the very ones that judged us. What remains to be seen is whether he will continue to be little more than a walking dead man who's given up or whether he'll take his fate - and the fate of the world - into his own hands.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: People in Gotham City are two-faced. Clayface, as one of the most skilled and dangerous shapeshifters, is adept at switching identities. Because of the malleability of the clay that makes up his body, he can shift into a variety of different forms. I now have to closely monitor Clayface and remain vigilant to prevent him from bringing disaster to Gotham City.

Pandora's knives and pistols are all from Marcus, a weapon smith in Baltimore, and the materials used to make her twin pistols must be from Wayne Industries. She focuses her magic through weapons. Physical attacks imbued with magical damage, quite clever.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Pandora was judged as the most sinful person in the world for opening the box, making her a part of Trinity of Sin, along with the Question and the Phantom Stranger. However, Pandora claims that she was manipulated into opening the box, which caused humanity to commit evil acts. She once hoped that Superman could open the box to free humans and her from the evil curse, but Superman failed and almost lost control (which is also evidence that Superman cannot resist a hostile spiritual takeover). The box was eventually opened by the Outsider, a lurker from the Elseworld, and no one ever thought that opening the box would bring destruction to the world. Perhaps I should say, it brought destruction once again.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: One night when Bruce was ten, a tragedy in Gotham's Crime Alley changed his life. After witnessing his parents gunned down, Bruce swore a vow to avenge them. He enhanced his body and knowledge through relentless training while developing a battery of high-tech weapons to fight crime. And Batman, who would come to prowl Gotham at night, was born. He's Gotham's nightmare, the hero in the darkness, and every criminal fears the sound of his name.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Oliver Queen used to be a true playboy. His parents' wealth allowed him to idle about every day. Until one day, he was trapped at sea and washed ashore on the deserted Starfish Island. It inspired his strong desire for survival. To save the enslaved people on the island, he honed his skills. Already proficient in archery, he finally defeated the drug runners and became the greatest archer ever.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Oliver Queen isn't a pleasant person, especially his manner of speaking and vain behavior. As important members of the Justice League, we've experienced a lot of things together and faced many cosmic crises. His fancy props are always useful in critical times. I never doubted his insistence on justice, even when I didn't trust him after he returned from the dead. But I have to admit, he's a good detective and super hero, and he's our important friend.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Of all the Robins, Tim Drake is the least likely to become Batman.
Now her leg function relies entirely on her spinal support implant, which can be paralyzed by an electromagnetic impulse, making her paralyzed again.

en: No matter what happens to Koriand'r, the Titans will be with her.

Nightwing's physical prowess is just one level below mine. With high agility and flexibility, he fights nimbly, as if he's dancing. He's a master of weaponry. His preferred weapon is a pair of batons.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Nanaue is a descendant of the Shark God, he possesses the blood of the old gods. However, he grew up in the human world. When he was a child, Amanda Waller took him from a water hole on a Hawaiian island to Belle Reve Penitentiary for training. He used to be a member of the Secret Six, and he also joined the Suicide Squad.

Nanaue can breathe on land and underwater. He has superhuman strength and stamina, as well as regenerative abilities. His teeth and claws can tear steel plates, and his skin is strong enough to withstand the pressure of the deep sea. He loses control when he smells blood.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Mr. Freeze's incentive for crime is as simple and pure as ice itself—he seeks money and valuables. But as stated, a tragic motivation fuels his crimes. He has no choice but to turn to crime to save his terminally ill wife, Nora. Mr. Freeze kept his wife suspended in ice for a long time and developed his own cryogenical dormancy technology to halt her disease from spreading. I tried to provide medical assistance to his wife in the name of Wayne Enterprises. I hope Nora can be cured one day.

Mr. Freeze can only survive in cold temperatures. He can create ice and instantly freeze targets with the ice gun he invented. His cryo-suit also grants him super durability and super strength, making him nearly invincible in cold environments.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Most of the time Arthur can handle his old foe. But, just to be safe, we need to take additional precautions. As the investigation progressed, I found that although Black Manta was mysterious, he was far from insane. He acted with a clear personal purpose and code, which made him predictable and gave us an advantage when confronting him.
Mirror Master can travel between the mirror and the real world. He invented his own mirror gun, which can trap others in a glass plane or create an illusion through a mirror to confuse enemies.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Mirror Master appears to be a disorderly thief. He became a super criminal by chance, and his plans were more akin to accidental events splicing together. He has vowed never to kill. If he ever crossed this line, he would become the deadliest man alive.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Many of the Gotham City Police Department's junior officers ignore The Penguin, mistaking him for an unremarkable arms dealer or mob boss, which is precisely where Cobblepot's cunning pays dividends. Unless The Penguin gets the itch to personally handle a job, you will never catch him in the act. Everyone knows the Iceberg Lounge is dirty, but it's still a place to be seen. He is a calculating strategist and brilliant in his deception. Physical combat is never the biggest threat when fighting him.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Like other young heroes, Ronnie and Jason sometimes think they deserve a better life than they have. They should enjoy their youth and freedom without being haunted by superpowers and responsibilities every moment. But they've done better than expected. Firestorm's ability is still a great mystery, but the league can try to trust them more.

Like every other Green Lantern, John possesses the ability to create constructs and fly, but he also possesses a strong leadership ability and excels as a leader. Meanwhile, his engineering knowledge allows him to create complex hard-light constructs.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Like Clark, J'onn is an orphan of a planet and a race. They came to Earth after their homeworlds were destroyed for various reasons, and Earth became J'onn's new home. For a long time, J'onn has been our reliable companion and a channel for cultural exchange between alien planets and Earth. J'onn has a lot more to offer us, and I hope we can help and console him.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Lex Luthor is one of the smartest men alive on Earth. He could have benefited the world with his deep pockets and superior intellect, but he turned to crime because of his arrogance and jealousy of Superman. As a human supremacist, he believes that Superman's existence weakens human potential, so he regards Superman as the greatest threat to humanity. He's also tried to change the world in a positive way in recent years. Is this another one of Luthor's conspiracies, or a fresh start? Anyway, I'm not going to give up watching him.

Lex Luthor is a master of strategy, technology, and words. Brainiac monitored and listed him as possessing "level 9 intelligence". He's also got a suit of mechanized armor, which was developed by LexTech.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Leonard Snart grew up with an abusive, alcoholic father and an absent mother. His sister Lisa was his only companion. Perhaps the first few robberies he planned were "for survival", but after the Flash caught him and threw him in jail, he turned against the Flash with all his heart.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Kyle Rayner was once just an ordinary, albeit gifted, artist struggling to make a living as a graphic designer. After a possessed Hal Jordan destroyed the Green Lantern Corps, Ganthet, the last surviving Guardian of the Universe, made Kyle Rayner the universe's last Green Lantern. At first, Kyle found the life of a Super Hero rather novel. It wasn't until his girlfriend, Alexandra DeWitt, died at the hands of a villain that Kyle realized the true weight and responsibility of the role. Despite the trauma and emotional turmoil, Kyle pressed on, helping to rebuild the Green Lantern Corps and protecting the Earth as a member of the Justice League.\n\nOne day, while saving a construction worker, Kyle was chosen to wield the other six rings in the Emotional Spectrum. Though this turned out to be the work of former Guardian Sayd, who had turned Kyle into a "ring magnet" in hopes that he would bring the seven Corps together to save an emotion-stripped Ganthet, Kyle nevertheless demonstrated the capacity to command every shade of the Emotional Spectrum. To defeat the corrupted Guardians, Kyle worked hard to master this ability and draw out his newfound powers. Only after diving deep into his psyche, reaching an emotional balance, and understanding the strengths of each shade was he awarded a White Lantern Ring.

Kyle's like a little brother to me, the kind who's objectively more talented than you in a way that you can't help but envy. And you can't even hate him for it because he's just that good of a guy. I thought I was a pretty good Lantern, but then Kyle showed up and not only united the Lantern Corps, but also developed the ability to tap into the entire Emotional Spectrum. How can you compete with that? But in all seriousness, I owe Kyle a lot. If he hadn't been there to pick up my slack, I don't know what would've happened to the universe. It certainly wouldn't have been good. So even though we may not always see eye-to-eye, and even though he practically stole my girlfriend, I respect him and can rest easy knowing the universe is in good hands.
Kryptonians are weakened by Kryptonite, and so is Jon. Other than that, he has a long way to go. For example, he still needs to learn how to fly alone at night.

Killer Frost mutated as a result of the laboratory accident, and she now possesses superpowers to manipulate ice and cold. According to our observations, she can produce extremely cold ice and reduce the temperature to a very low level.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Killer Frost could be considered Firestorm's arch nemesis, but we can't simply view her as a super-powered criminal. She never forgets what she learns, making her more dangerous than other super-powered criminals. Surprisingly, she can be our ally for a short time when we're in need. I admit that the Justice League should be thankful for that.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Killer Croc, also known as Waylon Jones, has a rare congenital medical condition that causes him to gradually take on crocodile features, like sharp teeth, claws, and scales. When he reached adulthood, he found work in a circus as a sideshow "freak" wrestling alligators. However, the circus owner was greedy and pocketed most of his earnings. Angry and desperate, Waylon felt he could no longer trust humans and turned to a life of crime and became Killer Croc.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Killer Croc resides in Gotham's sewers. He is frequently used as a vanguard or cannon fodder for other villains, and he has even been used by Bane to weaken me. Years of isolation severely impair Killer Croc's intelligence and humanity, making him increasingly difficult to communicate with. I must remain vigilant against him in case this lethal crocodile emerges from the sewers again and wreaks havoc in Gotham City.

Killer Croc possesses superhuman strength, speed, durability, reflexes, and regenerative powers. Plus, he is a terror to fight in the water, and his knowledge of the Gotham's underground sewers and tunnels is one of his deadliest assets.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Kid Flash is a young hero who's still getting used to his superpower and the problems that come with it. He has a good mentor and family members to rely on, but Speed Force is still an intractable power. We need to pay attention to his growth.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Kent Nelson followed his father to a Mesopotamian excavation site as a child. There, he met the sealed ancient immortal, Nabu, and was given the Helmet of Fate, Cloak of Destiny, and Amulet of Anubis, becoming the first Doctor Fate.\nAfter retiring, Kent met Khalid Nassour, his grandnephew and Nabu's current successor, and resumed his previous role. Together, they wield Nabu's power and combat Egypt's ancient monsters.
J'onn's most obvious weakness is his crippling fear of fire. Although he is not actually susceptible to fire, his fear can deprive him of his super powers and eventually cause him to burn himself.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: J'onn J'onzz, code name Martian Manhunter, is a super hero on Earth. He was born on Mars and was teleported to Earth by accident. While he was stuck on Earth, his people were destroyed. J'onn has stayed on Earth ever since, taking on the identity of John Jones and joining the Justice League as Martian Manhunter.

J'onn has many superpowers, including super strength, flight, and X-ray vision. His strength is comparable to Superman's. In addition, he also can shapeshift, become invisible, and establish telepathic links, as well as other special abilities derived from the Martian's physical traits.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Jonathan Kent is Clark Kent and Lois Lane's son, he is part Kryptonian and part human, a bridge between the two worlds. He was born with superpowers, and his interactions with the Justice League made him eager to follow in his father's footsteps to become an exceptional young hero. But obviously, it's not as simple as he thought. He still has a long way to go with his parents, allies, and teachers before donning Superman's cape.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Jonathan Crane was a former psychology professor with extensive chemistry knowledge. When he was younger, he was bullied at school; as he grew older, he devoted himself to the study of fear, attempting to overcome his own inner fear. With his talent, he developed fear toxin, a compound that makes people see what they fear most. Crane has since transformed into Scarecrow, spreading fear and chaos in Gotham.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Jon is a good kid. I often see Clark in him, but some parts of his character are more like Lois, so he's more energetic and charming than his father. Clark tries to protect him, but Jon is obsessed with becoming a pre-teen super hero. I can't say which way is the best for him to grow up, but I'm sure one day he'll become an even better person than his parents.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Jon is a compassionate Kryptonian fool who lacks tactical awareness. He'll outperform Superman just as I'll outperform my father.
Joker had tortured him with a crowbar and brutally killed him, which has become a terrible memory he will almost never forget.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: John Stewart is a more responsible and seasoned leader than Hal Jordan, so there is no need to worry that he will act rashly which will lead to mission failures. Whether as the leader of the Green Lantern Corps or a member of the Justice League, John is a dependable ally in any crisis.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: John served as a Sergeant in the Marine Corps. After leaving the Marines, he became an engineer, and it was during this time that the Guardians chose him to be Hal Jordan's replacement as a Green Lantern. During Hal's departure from the Green Lantern Corps, John became a full member, and he led the Green Lantern Corps for many years afterward.
John is a natural leader and is quite responsible, allowing him to make decisions in difficult situations while balancing the interests of the team with his own values.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: John Constantine was born in Liverpool to a working-class family. His family dates back to King Arthur's period. The magic power has carried on for generations in his family. He was taught magic at a young age to exact vengeance for his father, but soon he saw the impact of magic, which frightened him. After that, he's worked harder to study magic but has become particularly cautious about using it.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Jessica's heart was once filled with fear, but it still held on to an indomitable will and courage that even she was unaware of. She is still a young and inexperienced Green Lantern, but she has a unique and profound insight into everyone's potential, or inner heart. She still sees some darkness in the shadow of green hope, and we must not allow her fears to come to pass.

Jason, this will be my last letter for a while, maybe ever. I made a deal today. I agree to be some scientific pin cushion; they agree to let me out early. If I live. Crazy? Absolutely. But I'm what your mom used to call "wily." 

        Trust me. Someday, God willing, you'll have a son. Then you'll know what it's like to love him so much. You'll do anything to be with your boy again. I'll see you soon.

        Love, Dad.

--Letter from Wesley Todd to Jason Todd

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Jason Todd, a former Robin, died at the hands of Joker as a teenager. With the help of Talia, Jason has returned from the dead with the power of the Lazarus Pit. The experience of being killed by Joker and the influence of the Lazarus Pit made Jason violent after his resurrection. He viciously fought the gangs in Gotham. Gradually, Jason began to learn to control his anger, trying to put aside his enmity and rebuilding his relationship with the family.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Jason succeeded Dick and became Robin. I used to get along with him just like I did with Dick, which obviously didn't suit him and led to his death. Thanks to my principle of not killing people, Jason came back from the resurrection to find that I didn't kill Joker to avenge him, so he resented me for a time. As Red Hood, he is now practicing his own justice in a different way than Batman. He doesn't need my help anymore. Even if I don't fully agree with him, I will respect his choice and expect to see his achievements.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Jason may not want to admit it, but he can't refuse Batman or completely abandon Batman's teachings—none of us can.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: I've never approved of Helena's style, but as Dinah says, we can make sure she doesn't cross the line anymore.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: It's easy to mistake Starfire for a naive princess from some of her actions, but naive people can't maintain their nature after experiencing many wars. I'm vigilant around her like I am towards other aliens. I don't expect her to be a good person like Clark. I just hope she can learn to respect human society and integrate with it.
It won't be difficult for some of us to defend and destroy his weaponized boomerangs. Meanwhile, Digger has joined Waller's Suicide Squad to reduce his sentence, so now he restrains himself.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Isis uses the power of Isis, the ancient Egyptian goddess of life, and in our experience, borrowing power from a deity always comes at a cost, even if it is not paid upfront. It has been observed that Isis needs to invoke spells to perform most of her abilities. Is it possible to interrupt the invocations? This is yet to be confirmed.

Inexperience is often the greatest weakness of every young hero. What's more, he's no match for the Flash in the use of the Speed Force. Kid Flash isn't fast enough. We'll discover all of his shortcomings before he reaches adulthood.

en: Incredible, he has mystery written all over him. If even the world's greatest detective couldn't get to the bottom of this, we certainly won't. Hey, we could ask Zanny. She's a professional magician.
In contrast to his former enemy, Luthor's "flesh and blood" has become almost his only fatal weakness. Besides, his arrogance will also lead to his failure.

In addition to his peak physical condition, intellect, skills, and will, Bruce has designed all the high-tech weapons and equipment of the Bat series using Wayne Enterprises' massive wealth. I think he's done everything a human can do to arm himself.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: I'm not sure if the concept of justice still remains in someone like Floyd Lawton, but as I said before, anyone who can be recruited into Waller's team is still considered a criminal with potential. Deadshot may be one of the most lethal killers in the world, but his bullets and perches are nigh untraceable.

If we think of Cyborg as a supercomputer, then he must have defects, which means Cyborg can be damaged and controlled by some computer viruses. Additionally, a personality known as "Grid" was born from Cyborg's mechanical system. It may also be one of his weaknesses.
If Two-Face loses his coin or either of his plans fails, he will be incapacitated almost immediately.
If there is a weakness in madness, it must be her own.
If the tubes that pump Venom into his bloodstream are cut off, his physical ability will quickly return to normal human levels.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: I never thought I'd have a son, a real son. At first, I didn't know how to face him. In fact, Dick has done a lot better than I have in teaching Damian. I know Damian cares a lot about Talia, and I don't want to sever his relationship with his mother. But he'll have to make a choice between the League of Assassins and the Batman Family someday. After becoming Robin, Damian has been trying to prove himself to me, and I'll do my best to guide him. It's my responsibility as a father. I missed Damian's childhood, and I won't miss more.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: I miss the days before when Harvey was still himself. He was one of my few friends, and we worked together to fight crime and corruption in Gotham. But our crusade ended it all. Harvey became Two-Face, transforming from Gotham's beloved district attorney into a feared villain. Each of his appearances resulted in a dual disaster, even for me.

I hate to say kindness is a person's weakness, but if we need to control the Flash someday, we may have to take advantage of his goodwill... And, it has been observed that Speed Force can be taken away and transmitted, which is particularly common among the Flash family members. This can be considered a breakthrough. We need to conduct further research on it.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: I don't think I like this crocodile... But I have to admit that he has helped Roy, probably more than once.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: I do think Speed Force is a terrible power, but when it's possessed by someone with principles, it can be restricted in a manageable range. I'd say Barry Allen is the one I'd like to believe. Kindness is a good quality, and I respect him for it. Barry Allen might live a slow pace of life, but he's still too fast for this world. As his partner, I want to catch up with him, yet I also want to slow him down.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: I always blamed myself for Harleen Quinzel's transformation. She came to Gotham with good intentions and worked hard to care for criminals and find ways to help them. She wasn't like the other psychiatrists who approached Joker to make a name for themselves, and that's why she fell so easily into his trap—she genuinely cared about him. I should have expected Joker's cruelty and cunning, as well as his skill at manipulating people's hearts. He would never turn down an opportunity to corrupt a good person. I've tried several times to bring Harleen back, but I've never succeeded. It sometimes makes me wonder if Harley Quinn is Harleen's truest self. Even though she's matured and moved on from Joker, her madness has become more distinct. She's Harley Quinn, and she's only Harley Quinn.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: I admire Kid Flash.\n...I miss Wally West.

en: Here's some advice: When you need advice and don't want Batman to know, Superman is undoubtedly the best listener and guide. Even Batman agrees with that.
Helena doesn't have superpowers. Like me and most non-super heroes, she's made herself a handy and practical kit to fight criminals along with her excellent fighting skills.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Helena Bertinelli is the daughter of a mafia family in Gotham City. She was destined to grow up in chaos and violence with such a family in such a city. And that's not the worst of it: When she was eight, she witnessed the death of her parents and brothers—the story sounds familiar, right? She swore to avenge her family and received a series of training as I did. When she returned to Gotham again, she became Huntress.

He is skilled with farm tools such as rakes and scythes, as well as fear toxin. As an extraordinary professor of psychology, he intimately understands the power and use of fear, and he can manipulate people's emotions and consciousness with his words alone.
