Harvey used to be Gotham's most honest attorney. He is well-versed in the law and the workings of the city... This is far more dangerous than his proficiency all types of firearms.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Harvey Dent was once the District Attorney, an honest and brave man. Unfortunately, Maroni threw acid into his face in retaliation, severely disfiguring the left side. This attack changed Harvey, exposing his evil side. After becoming Two-Face, he created his own gang and is now one of the most feared gangsters in Gotham City. He is skilled at dealing with both the evil and righteous sides, which seems as simple as flipping a coin.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Harley was my therapist when I was in Arkham Asylum. I have to admit, she did quite well in her field.
Harley Quinn was a gymnastics champion in the past. Her agile body, insane fighting style, and proficiency with various weapons make her one of the most dangerous street villains.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Harleen Quinzel was once a great psychologist. She came to Arkham with the intention of helping others, but she met Joker there. Harleen was initially wary of Joker, but Joker studied the direction of her research, disguised himself as the ideal object of her study, and enticed Harleen into falling in love with him. He transformed her into Harley Quinn and led her down a path of crime with no return. Although Harley has now left Joker, she has long since been unable to revert to her former identity as Dr. Harleen.

Hal Jordan's ability to create constructs is one of the strongest among the Green Lanterns, and he is the only Green Lantern who can forge a Green Lantern Ring with his willpower, proof of his indomitable will. His willpower is strong enough to compete with the entire universe. In addition, Hal is an excellent pilot.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Hal is a founding member and pillar of the Justice League. He is not often seen on Earth because of his duties as a galactic police officer, but we all know he is protecting this sector in his own unique way. It's hard for me to say I approve of the way he acts and solves problems, but there's no denying that he's always been a reliable ally.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Grodd was one of the gorillas who evolved as a result of a meteor that crashed into Earth. Unlike most of the peace-loving gorillas from his tribe, Grodd is radical and ambitious, intending to conquer and dominate humans. After committing a shocking murder, Grodd became the new ruler of Gorilla City and wages war to conquer the world.

Green Arrow uses a compound bow and some special arrows as weapons. His experience on the desert island combined with his training ensure his physical strength, endurance, hearing, and vision are far above average. Beyond that, he's also a good fighter.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Given that he's a principled criminal, we might be able to lower his threat level and expect him to behave in certain special circumstances. But to me, a criminal is always a criminal. He's caused a lot of trouble for both the Flash and the Justice League, but I have to admit the trouble he's caused has been the easiest to solve. I'll keep an eye on Captain Cold, especially after Amanda Waller makes her attitude clear.

From Power Ring to a Green Lantern, with the help of her predecessors and allies, our new Green Lantern has finally begun to grasp the most powerful weapon in the universe. As we all know, a Green Lantern's true power comes not from the ring, but from the willpower that resides in their hearts.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: From Nightwing: To be objective, Bruce asked me to record him.
Frankenstein is seemingly unkillable, and to find his weaknesses, I must look into who he is whenever I make contact.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Frankenstein is an artificial being created by doctor Victor Frankenstein from the body parts of an estimate of fifty victims. Surprisingly, he has an innate sense of justice. After being awakened, he killed his maker and freed all of his remaining victims. This led to S.H.A.D.E. recruiting Frankenstein as an agent, where he has saved the world several times with no one being the wiser.

For those who are familiar with Helena's equipment, it's not difficult to defend against or counter them. Without the equipment, she has no additional advantages. On the other hand, she's not particularly mature, so it's not difficult to predict her actions.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Floyd Lawton, also known as Deadshot, was once an outstanding soldier. After leaving the army, he became a well-known mercenary and bounty hunter. He was imprisoned for attempting to assassinate a senator. Afterward, Amanda Waller recruited him for the Suicide Squad. Lawton saw this as an opportunity to have his sentence reduced in exchange for working for her.

Firestorm has the ability to rearrange the atomic and subatomic structures of inorganic substances, allowing him to create objects of equal mass with different atomic characteristics. This ability can also be applied to Firestorm to enhance his body.
Firestorm cannot use the power on organics other than themselves. As two heroes, Ronald and Jason must be more careful in dealing with situations that require a fusion.

Everyone has a weakness, including immortals. There are signs. Pandora had done everything in her power to fight the evils she released on her own, but it was all in vain, leaving her in a deep despair because she failed to stop the Seven Deadly Sins.
Every part of Frankenstein's body came from a different person. He doesn't need to eat or sleep, he doesn't age, and as long as his broken parts are replaced, he is technically immortal.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Even if the whole world crumbled apart, Dick wouldn't be corrupted. In the early years, I'd hoped he would don Batman's cape, but it turned out that he would be a much better person than I am and become who he was meant to be. Admittedly, as a young vigilante, Nightwing still has a way to go, but he's already proven his ability to deal with massive crises. Although I've never said it out loud, I'm proud of him. (PS: But that doesn't mean you can be complacent, Nightwing.)

Even if Bizarro has similar abilities to Superman's and isn't afraid of green Kryptonite, he can't compete with Superman because of his low IQ. There are also reports that Blue Kryptonite can damage Bizarro.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Dr. Isley was once a successful professional, but after she was betrayed by someone she admired and injected with plant toxins, she morphed into what she is now—Poison Ivy, a zealous defender of nature who believes that plants are more important than humans. She despises most humans and protects defenseless plants from human destruction; plants have become her weapons, protecting her at all times.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Dr. Caitlin Snow was a brilliant talent at S.T.A.R. Labs. She took over and completed the previous chief scientist's thermodynamic superconductor engine. H.I.V.E. agents almost killed her. In the accident, her body merged with ice, mutating into Killer Frost who suffers from emptiness. She gained the power of ice and snow but always longs for heat from living beings.

Doctor Fate's magic abilities are almost unparalleled. He himself has power that affects the order of the universe. But his resolute belief in truth and justice has also plunged him into a near-death crisis. I'll continue to watch him and keep recording.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Doctor Fate possesses the strongest magic known to date, almost without any weaknesses. He can be as fast as Superman and the Flash, he's better at mind control than Martian Manhunter, and better at time travel than Booster Gold... I've got to admit, in the face of God, mortal power has its limits. But for the peace of the universe and to deal effectively with anything that might happen, I still need a plan that can restrain Doctor Fate.

Dinah's most well-known ability is Canary Cry, which allows her to create ultrasonic vibrations with tenfold the capabilities of sonic weapons whenever she screams. She's also an outstanding fighter who is proficient in all kinds of martial arts. Her hand-to-hand combat abilities rival my own.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Dinah Lance was born in Gotham, an environment that was far from beautiful. Before becoming the Black Canary, she was trained by many top-tier fighters to develop excellent fighting skills and camouflage. Many people are impressed by her beauty, but what she relies on is her incredible strength. Watch out, her beautiful voice is more deadly than anyone can imagine.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Dinah has long been our trusted partner and one of the Justice League's most reliable members. She's strong, intelligent, powerful, and has an intense sense of justice. We should thank Dinah for training our young heroes. Obviously, she's taught them more than fighting skills. The only thing worth noting is that her relationship with Green Arrow is a safety net, but it's also a variable.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Diana said you believed that Ollie would be the last of everyone to get married. Bruce, I guess that's the main reason you refused to attend Ollie and Dinah's wedding in the first place, even if you finally arrived in time.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Diana may be a warrior, but her compassion means that she has a soft and kind heart. She doesn't allow herself to coexist with lies, nor does she allow herself to ignore evil or crime. She's a worthy defender of truth and justice. If Diana had fallen, it would have been by her own choice. And at that time, I didn't think anything other than force could stop her.

Diana is not invulnerable, even she can't withstand the power of the Lasso of Truth. As an Amazon Soldier, she always fights to the end. It is a virtue, of course, but it can also be her greatest weakness.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Diana has talked to me many times about The Cheetah. She's angry and sad for her. Diana insisted that she could handle her rival, and out of her confidence and pride, she didn't want us to interfere. But I must point out that The Cheetah has been involved in criminal organizations many times, proving she may be hostile to the entire Justice League. And The Cheetah's over-targeting Wonder Woman also worries me. We need to watch Diana's back.
Despite his exceptional physical and healing abilities, he has his limitations. As a mercenary, the principle of profit over all else seems to influence his actions.

Despite being a skilled hand-to-hand combatant, Black Manta is also a mechanical expert. With his triphibian battle suit, he can enhance his physical strength, fly in the air, and breathe underwater like the Atlanteans. The suit also has a number of lethal weapons built into it, such as rays from his helmet and a telepathic scrambler.

Deadshot is a marksman that always hits his mark. He is well-versed in every type and caliber of firearm, and he is in peak physical and athletic condition. He is armed with a variety of weapons and protective armor.
Deadshot has no superpowers, and his weapons and abilities are ultimately limited. His daughter also keeps his soul in his world.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Daughter of Zeus, Diana is a demigod Princess from Themyscira. She is the hand of peace extended to the outside world by the Amazons and the guardian of truth and justice. She was trained to be a good soldier, but it was after entering humanity's world that she saw violence and conflict for the first time. She is the founder and one of the leaders of the Justice League. Her courage, wisdom, and adherence to justice inspires not only heroes, but thousands of ordinary people.
Damian's greatest weakness is his pride and complacency. He's not good at getting along with his peers, which often causes trouble when he works in teams.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Damian still has a lot to learn, not just in combat. But he's proven that he can be dependable—as a partner and a member of the family.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Damian is the son of Talia and me. He was born and grew up unconventionally. He received strict training in the League of Assassins and was instilled with vast knowledge as well as al Ghul's arrogance. It wasn't until he was ten that I became aware of his existence and brought him back to Gotham. At first he didn't adapt well to life there. He was trained to be ruthless, scornful toward life, and dangerous. But after a series of trials and tests, he proved that he was qualified to be Robin and stayed in the Batman Family.

Damian has several PhDs. He can use numerous weapons and has mastered many killing skills. He's the only Robin with a sword, and he's less skilled at "defeating" than "killing". I need to train him more carefully.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Cyborg often helps the Teen Titans. In the Justice League, he's one of the few who are willing to communicate with and try to understand others.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Little is known about the Phantom Stranger. There are many legends and rumors regarding his origins. The most reputable indicate that he was once a mortal human who committed a grave betrayal. After his death, he was brought before the Circle of Eternity, who condemned him for his actions. They charged him with avarice and sentenced him to an eternity of wandering the Earth anonymously, a stranger and spectator to all. Historical records show that he has been present for numerous pivotal events throughout the centuries. But what influence he may have had over those events is unknown.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Constantine once summoned Pandora, the Phantom Stranger, and the Question to fight Blight together, but the Question didn't join them. We still know very little about the Question. Who is he? Where does he come from? What is he looking for in this world? The Question himself may not know any more than we do. With the demise of the Council of Eternity, will we ever know the truth?
Constantine is a powerful sorcerer, but he rarely uses magic. He has paid a heavy price for the magic he's used, so he would rather achieve his goals through trickery, investigation, or deal-making.

Compared to other more skilled and mature Green Lanterns, Jessica is not as resilient, which is due to her earlier trauma. Furthermore, she has not yet truly mastered the power of her ring, and accidents are common.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Cobblepot was born into one of Gotham's oldest and most influential families, but he was teased a lot as a child and was nicknamed The Penguin because of his appearance, affecting his self-esteem. As he grew up, his desire for respect twisted into a thirst for evil and to be feared by others, eventually leading him to become one of Gotham's most feared mob bosses.

Cobblepot is brilliant. He has honed his skills, like bird training and hand-to-hand fighting, and is also a master bird trainer. Even Joker would not dare underestimate him. And he is never seen without an umbrella, which hides a menagerie of weapons, including machine guns, blades, acid, or poison gas.
Cobblepot despises disobedience, which can be exploited. He also has an inflated sense of self-worth because of his childhood and can be easily enraged when disrespected.
Clayface's body is almost entirely made of mud, so cold and water are excellent ways to deal with him.

Clayface has shapeshifting abilities. Because the clay that makes up his body is extremely sticky and malleable, he can transform into any shape or weapon, become soft enough to enter any object or as hard as a rock, mimic anyone's body, and be immune to all weapons. He is virtually unkillable.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Clark is the most human among us. He fell from the sky, and it's hard not to see him as a god. Fortunately, he never wanted to be a god. I have no doubt about Clark's loyalty and principles. But his mind has been controlled several times, and there are people who want to replicate his abilities. I need to take every precaution to prevent such incidents when necessary. Clark also understands this necessity, and that's why he left the original Kryptonite in my custody.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Carol's father, Carl Ferris, owns Ferris Aircraft. He retired to travel the world, leaving his business to his daughter Carol, who ended up employing Hal Jordan. Carol is an elite entrepreneur and pilot, and by chance, she was chosen by a Star Sapphire Ring and became a member of the Star Sapphire Star Sapphire Corps.

Captain Cold lacks superpowers, but he is gifted with intelligence and strategy. With his ability and wisdom, he assembled a Cold Gun capable of emitting a ray that can freeze anything to absolute zero temperatures. Even Barry slows down in this low temperature.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Captain Boomerang, also known as George "Digger" Harkness, was raised in Australia. He is skilled with boomerangs and enjoya using them as weapons. What I discovered was that he was initially impoverished after immigrating and began stealing with his boomerang skills until the Flash caught him and threw him in jail.

Captain Boomerang is a regular guy with no superpowers, but he is unusually adept at throwing boomerangs. He makes various types of weaponized boomerangs and uses them to commit crimes or for other purposes in combat.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Can you believe it? Wally told me that to deal with Grodd, the Flash learned gorilla sign-language!
Caitlin Snow longs for heat, or rather, the heat of life. Absorbing the energy of Firestorm once turned her back into a human. However, too much heat could harm or kill her.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: But can you imagine? John Constantine smokes in the Batmobile!

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Bruce... Batman is the greatest man I've ever met. He's a hero who's done things that no one else can ever do. But I still have concerns: On the one hand, he's become a shelter for many people, including the entire city and the league. On the other hand, he never left Crime Alley on that fateful night. Perhaps no one has ever been able to see inside his heart, but I'll try my best to support him and understand him. I hope that I—or we—can be his rock.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Born in the circus, Dick used to be an acrobat, he was the youngest member of the Flying Graysons. I witnessed all of his tragedies, which were similar to mine. It was hard for me to ignore the future he might experience. I adopted him, but he discovered my secret and chose to be Robin. He's full of charm and has tremendous potential. He even started the Teen Titans as a teenager. I'm sure Nightwing can achieve much more.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Born in Coast City, Hal Jordan grew up with a passion for the skies and flight. He idolized his father, a test pilot who worked for Ferris Aircraft. Although his father died in a plane crash at an air show, he still wanted to fly. When he was 18, he joined the United States Air Force and later worked as a test pilot. Due to his exceptional will and bravery, he was chosen as a Green Lantern. He was the first human ever inducted into the Green Lantern Corps, a founding member of the Justice League, and has been heralded as possibly the greatest Green Lantern of all time.

Black Manta's weaponry is a significant threat, but it also means that if he is separated from his high-tech equipment, his fighting ability will significantly weaken. Even though some of us can subdue him, we should still be aware of his hand-to-hand combat skills.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Black Manta's best-known identity is Aquaman's old foe. Their feud stems from the misfortune that befell their fathers—they had both unintentionally killed each other's fathers. The sea criminal and his family experienced a series of mishaps that forged him step by step, now he travels through the seven seas with high-tech weapons. And, on rare occasions, he joins the good side to fight evil.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Bizarro—at least my Bizarro—deserves to be trusted. What did you say? Did you ever look into his eyes?

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Bizarro was created in Lex Luthor's laboratory. As an imperfect duplicate of Superman, Bizarro lacks his intelligence and self-control. Sometimes misguided, sometimes genuinely malevolent, and even sometimes a true hero himself, Bizarro is nevertheless a force to be reckoned with.\nOften a creature more to be pitied than feared, Bizarro nevertheless is as dangerous as it gets—whether he means to be lethal or not.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Bizarro isn't a perfect Superman replica, so he clearly doesn't meet Luthor's expectations. Despite his ugly appearance, I must admit that he still has good intentions, and he's determined to become a hero loved by everyone like Superman. Lacking intelligence and self-control, he's often used by people with ulterior motives to do bad things. Bizarro's existence seems to be further proof of the disaster an uncontrolled Superman can bring to the world.

Bizarro has most of Superman's abilities: super speed, superhuman strength, super hearing, flight... But in contrast to Superman, Bizarro has Arctic Vision and Flame-Breath; he's not afraid of Kryptonite, he can even increase his strength by absorbing it. However, Bizarro's X-ray vision only allows him to see through lead.

Kyle Rayner wields a White Lantern Ring, which enables him to manipulate the white light of life and creation. In addition to giving Kyle the ability to create constructs, he can also generate an atmospherically stabilized force field, phase through solid objects, heal, and even see the "souls" or essence of those who have recently died. With the ability to harness the powers of the entire Emotional Spectrum, Kyle is one of the most powerful Lanterns. He is really only limited by his imagination, of which he has plenty.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Basil Karlo was severely disfigured in a car accident during his film acting career. To save his career, he used an experimental putty to cover his scars, a substance that had not yet been fully developed, and it turned his body into malleable clay. Even worse for Basil, another actor had been cast in his role. So, he plotted to attack the film crew in retaliation, and he has roamed Gotham as Clayface since.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Barbara's returned to us—I mean, she's been a lot of help as Oracle. But fighting together? This is really exciting.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Barbara Gordon is the daughter of Police Commissioner Jim Gordon. She designed and sewed a Batsuit due to her admiration for Batman and her father. After that, I accepted her as a disciple and gave her special training. Despite her paralysis, which was caused by Joker, Barbara hasn't given up on her vigilante career and has returned as "Oracle" to help other heroes. With the help of supporting equipment, she once again stands on her own two feet and returns to Gotham with a familiar identity.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Barbara Ann Minerva, an archaeologist, was a close friend of Wonder Woman and one of the first people to guide Diana into modern society. When she was trapped in an African jungle during an adventure, Diana didn't show up in time. Barbara, who was later cursed and became the bloodthirsty "The Cheetah", blamed her experiences on her former best friend. She keeps her eye on her prey at all times like a real predator.

Bane was born with a genius-level IQ that rivals Batman's, and while he's a physically strong villain, he often fights using his intellect. After injecting Venom, his body is greatly enhanced, with superhuman strength, speed, and endurance.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Bane was born in a prison. The harsh environment shaped his strong physique; he became self-taught, fought for survival on a daily basis, and eventually rose to become a hero in the prison. Later, as a test subject, he was injected with Venom, a super steroid drug that had killed all previous subjects. He caused a series of chaos in Gotham City with his strong combat power and super intelligence, and even briefly took control of the city.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述3（完整）
en: B.W.: "I swear on the souls of my parents that I'll spend my life fighting every criminal to avenge them."

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: At this point, the Flash is still capable of dealing with Grodd and the troubles he causes. I'm more concerned about the attitudes of other factions in Gorilla City. The issues raised by the appearance of a completely new native race in the world demand more careful confrontation and in-depth consideration than the appearance of a super villain. If Gorilla City reveals its disguise and enters the public sphere, we need to keep a close eye on any subsequent issues for a long time.
As Robin, Tim's biggest problem is that he lacks advantages when it comes to physical strength and fighting. So he has to be more cautious in many situations.
As long as the mirror is broken and the light source is cut off, he can be trapped in the mirror.
As a vigilante, Nightwing's biggest problem is that he overexerts himself so much that he often puts himself in danger.

As a "gifted magician", Zatanna possesses the ability to manipulate mysterious forces to use magic. Her most common magic is "backward spells" and her most dangerous ability is "mind-wipe". Zatanna has used it to interfere with many people's minds, including mine, which makes her especially dangerous.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Anyone who can be recruited into Waller's team is considered a criminal with potential. According to our research, Captain Boomerang's background and criminal behavior are relatively simple, but even in a team of well-known criminals like the Suicide Squad, George "Digger" Harkness is one of their most dangerous. He's no longer just the Flash's enemy, and he's certainly not Waller's man.

Amulet of Anubis, Helmet of Fate, and Cloak of Destiny. These magical weapons from the ancient Egyptian immortals give Doctor Fate unparalleled power, including: superhuman strength, super speed, telepathy, immortality, invisibility, magnetic manipulation, telekinesis, clairvoyance, dimensional travel, and more.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述2（完整）
en: Although the vengeance I wished on The Penguin once caused Batman to stop me, I swear I truly had mercy.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Although the chaos of time and space that caused everything hasn't been fully investigated and many problems still remain, it's a fact that Speed Force chose Wally West, and the Flash has admitted him into the Speedster Family. The ability is too powerful for the new Kid Flash, who's still learning how to use it, but the growth of a young hero is worth noticing.
Although Superman is the Man of Steel, Kryptonite and magic can easily damage him. Red sun radiation can also weaken Superman's power.

Although Superboy can't control them as well as Superman, he has almost all of Superman's abilities. At present, some of his superpowers are still awakening, and this instability is very dangerous during operations.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Although she's a member of the Star Sapphire Corps, she rarely appears in space as a Star Sapphire. She seems to prefer her ordinary life. But she's always there for Hal when he needs her. I believe that's why the Star Sapphire Ring chose her. Even though she and Hal have had a tumultuous relationship, she keeps loving him, just like how she keeps the ring hidden deep in a drawer.

Although dangerous, The Cheetah is still a simple and instinctive fighter. She is academically intelligent, but lacks the ability to plan crimes and conspiracies. However, I know Diana will not lose to anyone in combat.
Although Crane is a self-proclaimed fear artist with great confidence in his fear toxin, I've used it to defeat him several times.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: Although Constantine is petulant and has vague moral lines, people questioning his motives do not appear to influence his desire for justice, and his friends and allies stay by his side.

The Circle of Eternity cursed the Phantom Stranger to an eternity of bystanding. Though he can see the future, he can never directly intervene and is relegated to merely influencing others to action. Therefore, despite his enormous magical potential, he is of limited use in an actual battle or crisis. He is also susceptible to magic himself.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述3（完整）
en: After experiencing so much, I often feel that... Nightwing is the best of us.

Module: 角色档案-身份来历（完整）
en: Adrianna Tomaz is from Kahndaq. She was enslaved and brought to Black Adam, the ruler of Kahndaq, as a gift from Intergang. Black Adam admired her uprightness and bravery, giving her the amulet of the Queen Pharoah Hatshepsut of ancient Egypt and transforming her into the powerful Isis. Adrianna was later killed in retaliation by Intergang. Black Adam was so devastated by her death that he attempted to strike a deal with the evil wizard Felix Faust to bring her back.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述1（完整）
en: According to the S.H.A.D.E., before recruiting Frankenstein, they put him through a series of stress tests, which proved that he is trustworthy in terms of his sense of justice. However, Frankenstein is not human, and he doesn't experience sickness and death as humans do. As an artificial creation deemed a monster, how does he feel about the human race? What are his philosophies on the evil and crime in the world? I have to keep a close eye on him to figure this out.

Module: 角色档案-备注描述3（完整）
en: A question that many people may have: Who's faster, the Flash or Superman? According to records from the Watchtower, they've raced plenty of times and the results were close. But the Flash claims he let Superman win.
White Lantern - Kyle

Explanation: 英雄称号白灯侠凯尔/列表文字换行
en: White Lantern - Kyle
They made an exception to the "no white after Labor Day" rule for me.

en: The Super Hero and King of the Seven Seas that came to be known as Aquaman had humble beginnings. Born to a human lighthouse keeper and an Atlantean queen, Arthur Curry spent most of his life living in Amnesty Bay, unaware of his royal heritage. When he finally discovered his birthright and took the throne as an adult, he became the most legendary king in Atlantean history, his appreciation and understanding of humans leading to unprecedented diplomatic relations between Atlantis and the surface world. A founding member of the Justice League of America, Aquaman has fought alongside Superman, Batman, and Wonder Woman to fend off countless universe-threatening foes.
Aquaman possesses telepathy, superhuman strength, and the Trident of Poseidon.

Owing to his half-Atlantean physiology, Aquaman possesses superhuman strength, durability, dexterity, and senses. Naturally adapted to the deep, he is able to breathe underwater and endure water pressures that would crush an ordinary human. His connection to the Life Force allows him to telepathically communicate with fish and other forms of sea life. Though arguably not as gifted as his wife, Mera, Aquaman is also able to manipulate and control water. The Trident of Poseidon he wields also grants him a variety of mystical powers and enchantments, including the ability to manipulate weather and fly.
Dehydration can weaken and diminish Aquaman's powers.

While Aquaman is able to spend more time on dry land than a full-blooded Atlantean, he is still acutely susceptible to dehydration. Depriving him of water for an extended period of time can weaken his strength and powers.

Alone and survivor's guilt-stricken, she channeled her grief into becoming Supergirl. But with all of Superman's powers and none of his experience or self-restraint, she struggles to find her place in this unfamiliar world.
Cousin to Superman and one of the few surviving Kryptonians, Kara Zor-El now uses the powers she derives from Earth's yellow sun to defend her adoptive home as Supergirl.
A native of the planet Krypton, Kara's father helped her escape its destruction.

Kara was born in Argo City on the planet Krypton to scientist Zor-El and Alura In-Ze. There she lived with her family until her teenage years, when it became clear Krypton was destined for destruction. In an attempt to save his daughter, Zor-El sealed Kara away inside an escape pod and jettisoned her into the galaxy in search of a safer planet. She remained in space in a form of hypersleep for years until her ship eventually crashed to the Earth. When she awoke, she discovered that she had superpowers - courtesy of the Earth's yellow sun - and that Kal-El, her infant cousin, was now fully grown and going by the name Clark Kent and moniker Superman. He explained to her that Krypton had been gone for decades, but she refused to believe him. It wasn't until she saw Krypton for herself that it truly sank in that her entire family and the only home she'd ever known was gone. Though struggling with survivor's guilt and feelings of loss and loneliness, she tries to look forward, adopting the Earth as her home and crusading as Supergirl in order to prevent what happened to Krypton from happening to another planet.
As a Kryptonian, Kara possesses superhuman abilities and invulnerability.

Kara's Kryptonian physiology allows her to absorb radiation from the Earth's yellow sun, granting her superhuman strength, speed, stamina, invulnerability, longevity, and the ability to fly. She can also see through any matter except lead, fire beams of energy from her eyes, and create hurricane force winds by exhaling air from her lungs.
Like all Kryptonians, Kara can be rendered powerless with Kryptonite.

Alec Holland was born with an innate and powerful connection to the Green, the elemental force that connects all plant life in the universe. Though he wouldn't realize it until much later, he had already been chosen to become its next Avatar—the Green's champion and the living embodiment of the elemental force that animates all plant life—by the Parliament of Trees—the collective conscious of all the Green's former Avatars—following the death of his predecessor. Driven by a subconscious urge to protect the environment, he became a biochemist and set to work developing a fertilizer that would stimulate hormonal growth in plants. This Bio-Restorative Formula, as he would come to call it, was capable of making even barren land cultivatable. He had just completed his work when tragedy struck.\n\nUnbeknownst to the Parliament of Trees, the Rot—the elemental force of death and decay and natural enemy of the Green—had been watching Alec for some time too. They sent their Avatar, Anton Arcane, to kill the ambitious scientist. Wearing the flesh of Alec's wife, he tampered with Alec's equipment. The explosion that followed set both Alec and his lab ablaze. Alec died while fleeing into the swamp and the embrace of the Green. For six months, the Parliament of Trees worked to resurrect Alec. When Alec finally awoke, he was haunted by memories that weren't his and wanted nothing to do with the Green. It wasn't until the Rot kidnapped his budding love interest, Abby Arcane, that he chose to accept his destiny and become the plant monster known as Swamp Thing.

Ancient, lightning-powered champion who rules Kahndaq with ruthless justice.

Black Adam was born Teth-Adam in ancient Kahndaq and chosen by the wizard Shazam to become his champion, gaining immense magical powers from ancient gods. After tragedy and betrayal hardened him, Adam turned against those he believed were corrupt and was ultimately stripped of his status and imprisoned for centuries. Magic lightning, super strength, flight, and near-invulnerability.

Black Adam draws his power from ancient gods by speaking the magic word “Shazam,” transforming into a being of immense magical might. He possesses superhuman strength, speed, stamina, durability, and flight, rivaling the greatest heroes on Earth. His signature weapon is divine lightning, which he can summon as devastating bolts from the sky or channel directly through his body in combat. In addition to raw power, he has centuries of combat experience, enhanced wisdom, and resistance to most conventional weapons.
Vulnerable to powerful magic and his own rage and pride.

Black Adam is highly vulnerable to powerful magic, especially spells or artifacts capable of countering or draining divine energy. Preventing him from speaking or disrupting the magic word “Shazam” can interfere with his transformation or destabilize his power. Despite his immense strength, he is also driven by intense pride, rage, and personal attachment to Kahndaq and his queen Isis, which enemies can exploit to provoke reckless decisions or manipulate him emotionally.
